theorems.name: Submission.cmcsd_gr_exists_deriv_le_off_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (B : ℝ≥0∞) (N : Set ℝ), Monotone F → 0 < ρ → ENNReal.ofReal (F ρ - F (ρ / 2)) ≤ B → (volume : Measure ℝ) N = 0 → ∃ r ∈ Ioo (ρ / 2) ρ, r ∉ N ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (deriv F r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 / ρ) * B
